entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Acyasamco coo Dios Sivaninquiscama alha Iñip Apyan oyleiqiojo umñian opayicsejo. Acyasamco coo Dios janjay apyimatemhip acma aquilitam pai joe Dios apasmom najan ayasomquitia avanquihip Dios emyoe.
